subject: flying fish
title: This Fish Launches Out of the Sea and Glides 1,300 Feet

scenes.text: This fish escapes predators by leaving the ocean.
It speeds up underwater, then bursts through the surface at up to 45 miles an hour.
Then it spreads its huge fins like wings and glides.
A single glide is about 160 feet. But it can dip its tail back in the water and push off again.
Chain those glides together and it can cover 1,300 feet, staying airborne for around 40 seconds.
It isn't really flying. Scientists call it gliding. A fish that treats the sky as an escape route.

description:
This fish escapes predators by leaving the ocean.
Flying fish launch at up to 45 mph and can glide about 1,300 feet by pushing off the water with their tails.
Would you ever expect a fish to do this?
